basis: ADM’s February 3 earnings release first established the threshold crossing. Its Consolidated Statements of Earnings report revenue of $18,556 million for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, against $21,498 million for the quarter ended December 31, 2024. Revenue fell 13.68%, below the $20,423.1 million cutoff. Both figures include Other Business. The earlier disclosures reviewed gave no numeric upper bound for Q4 consolidated revenue.

coverage.detail: February 4, 2025. The original Q4 2024 consolidated revenue was $21,498 million, matching the comparative figure in the Q4 2025 release.
August 5 Q2 release. ADM guided to approximately $4.00 in full-year adjusted EPS and expected improved margins to benefit Q4 and beyond. Neither measure set a Q4 revenue ceiling.
August 5 Q2 call. Management discussed the timing of margin improvements, annual adjusted EPS and capital spending. It gave no numeric Q4 consolidated sales forecast.
September 3 Barclays conference. The CEO discussed the timing of Nutrition plant improvements and uncertainty over how much benefit would fall in Q4 versus Q1. The $4 figure discussed was annual EPS.
September 23 Alltech announcement. ADM expected the North American animal-feed joint venture to launch in Q1 2026. The announcement supplied no revised Q4 2025 consolidated revenue base or forecast.
November 4 Q3 release. ADM reduced full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $3.25–$3.50. It supplied no annual revenue outlook from which to infer Q4 sales and no explicit Q4 consolidated revenue range.

November 4 Q3 call. Management projected a roughly 10% year-over-year decline in Q4 ethanol EBITDA margin and quantified expected insurance proceeds by segment. Neither forecast established a decline in consolidated revenue.

November 4 Q3 presentation. The GAAP summary reported $20,372 million of Q3 revenue and $61,713 million for the first nine months. As a retrospective cross-check, February’s full-year actual of $80,269 million less $61,713 million equals the directly reported Q4 actual of $18,556 million.

December 3 Goldman Sachs conference. Asked whether Q4 was meeting expectations, management discussed the booked Q4 business, soft crush margins and similar crush conditions extending into Q1. It gave no dollar or percentage bound for Q4 consolidated revenue.
January 12, 2026. ADM scheduled its Q4 results for February 3 without disclosing preliminary sales.

January 27 release, filed January 28. ADM announced a $40 million settlement concerning historical intersegment sales. It supplied no Q4 2025 consolidated revenue figure or revision to the comparative quarter.
February 3 actuals. ADM’s investor-relations release dates the announcement and reports both December-quarter revenues in the consolidated GAAP table.
EDGAR records acceptance of the results 8-K and its Exhibit 99.1 on February 3, 2026 at 06:03:39.

publication_date_evidence: ADM’s investor-relations release is dated February 3, 2026 and identifies the results as announced that day. The SEC accepted the matching earnings release as Exhibit 99.1 the same morning.
